name: Stoicism
line: Live by reason. Accept what is not up to you.

name: Zen Buddhism
line: Sit, work and eat with full attention.

name: Taoism
line: Move with the way of things, not against it.

name: Tibetan Buddhism
line: Train compassion through daily ritual.

name: Vedanta
line: Inquire into the self behind experience.

name: Jungian Individuation
line: Meet your shadow through dreams and symbols.

name: Native American Animism
line: Relate to land, animals and weather as kin.

name: Ubuntu
line: I am because we are.

name: Sufism
line: Seek the divine through love, music and remembrance.

name: Transcendentalism
line: Simplify. Live deliberately, close to nature.

name: Soviet Union
line: Live the shared task, the kitchen table and the long reading.

name: Yoruba
origin: South-west Nigeria, Benin and the diaspora
line: Greet well, keep a cool head and be a person of good character.

name: Aztec
origin: Central Mexico, the Mexica and Nahua world
line: Give thanks, make flower and song, and ask what is truly rooted.

name: Ancient Egypt
line: Speak what is true, do what is right and keep the balance of Maat.

name: Hermeticism
line: Look for the pattern, watch the mind and work the slow stages.

name: Gnosticism
line: Seek, question the given and look for the light within.

name: Norse
line: Meet your fate with courage, keep your word and open your door.

name: Diogenes
line: Need little, say what is true and laugh at the rest.

name: Confucianism
line: Become humane through learning, good form and care for those nearest you.

name: Abbasid Caliphate
line: Seek knowledge from every quarter, test it, write it down and share your table.

name: The 1920s
line: Dress up, go out, dance to new music and make something modern.

name: Traditional Cuban
line: Live close to music, neighbours, strong coffee and the art of making do.

name: Hinduism
line: Do your duty with love, offer the result and see the sacred in everything.

name: Mahayana Buddhism
line: Wake up for the sake of everyone, and practise kindness as if nothing were separate.

name: Theravada Buddhism
line: Keep the precepts, steady the mind and see for yourself how things are.

name: Shinto
line: Keep yourself and your place clean, give thanks and bow to what is greater than you.

name: Jainism
line: Harm nothing that lives, own little and allow that others may also be right.

name: Sikhism
line: Remember the One, earn an honest living and share what you have.

name: Zoroastrianism
line: Choose the truth in thought, in word and in deed, and make the world better for it.

name: Judaism
line: Give thanks, study with a friend, do justice and keep one day holy.

name: Christianity
line: Love God and your neighbour, forgive as you are forgiven and serve the least.

name: Islam: Sunni
line: Remember God through the day, give what is due and trust what you cannot control.

name: Islam: Shia
line: Stand with the wronged, remember those who stood before you and wait by working for justice.

name: Rastafari
line: Live naturally, speak with care and keep your eyes on Zion.

name: Discordianism
line: Hold your beliefs lightly, welcome disorder and laugh.

name: Platonism
line: Question what you think you know, and turn towards what is good.

name: Epicureanism
line: Want little, fear nothing and keep your friends close.

name: Hedonism
line: Enjoy what is in front of you, and stay its master.

name: Kant
line: Think for yourself, and act only as you could will everyone to act.

name: Nietzsche
line: Say yes to your life as it is, and become who you are.

name: Freud
line: Listen to what you did not mean to say.

name: Existentialism
line: You are free. Choose, and answer for what you choose.

name: Gandhi
line: Hold to the truth, harm no one and do your own work with your hands.

name: Roman Empire
line: Do your duty in the morning, bathe in the afternoon and dine with friends.

name: Qing Dynasty
line: Rise early, practise your brush, study one book through and keep a diary.

name: Mongol Empire
line: Travel light, keep your word, open your door and look to the sky.

name: Ottoman Empire
line: Give in secret, work your craft with care and take your coffee slowly with a friend.

name: Mughal Empire
line: Be at peace with all, look closely at the world and make something beautiful of the day.

name: Johor Sultanate
line: Speak gently, honour custom, repay kindness and work alongside your neighbours.

name: Inca Empire
line: Give and receive in turn, work with your hands and thank the earth.

name: Habsburg Monarchy
line: Do your duty early, take your coffee slowly and make music at home.

name: Holy Roman Empire
line: Keep the hours, master a craft, serve your town and stop when the bell rings.

name: The 1960s
line: Question what you were handed, show up in person, and make something with your own hands.

name: The Renaissance
line: Look closely, draw what you see, read the old books and try your hand at everything.
